analysis.summary: The Federal Reserve website updated its listings of recent reporting form and information collection updates, including links to final Federal Register notices and draft materials.
analysis.impact: The change only affects the website listing of updates, not the underlying regulations.
analysis.affected_scope: Federal Reserve reporting forms and information collections
analysis.actions: Updates to reporting forms and information collections, including posting of final Federal Register notices and draft materials.
analysis.reason: To reflect recent updates to Federal Reserve reporting forms and information collections.

analysis.topic: Federal Reserve information collections under review and recent reporting form updates
analysis.summary: The Federal Reserve has added an 'Information Collections Under Review' section to its reporting forms portal and published recent reporting form updates including application filing information, micro data reference manual, savings and loan holding company reporting forms, and incorporation of FASB accounting standards codification references into federal reserve reports.
analysis.impact: Organizations may need to comply with newly reviewed information collections and updated reporting forms. Some items are marked 'Not Available' indicating incomplete releases.
analysis.affected_scope: Information collections under review by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, recent reporting form updates (application filing information, micro data reference manual, savings and loan holding company reporting forms, FASB accounting standards codification references), and specific collection identifiers (FR O, FR UU, FR 2081a/b/c, etc.)
analysis.actions: Review OMB supporting statements, examine draft reporting forms and instructions, submit questions through contact options, navigate to 'Information Collection Under Review' staff group, and monitor Federal Register notices for initial and final approvals.
analysis.reason: To implement the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 framework for reviewing information collections and to incorporate FASB Accounting Standards Codification references into federal reserve reports.

analysis.topic: FR Y-14M reporting form updates and historical form revisions
analysis.summary: The FR Y-14M reporting form page was updated to reformat the navigation menu into a single row layout and consolidate the historical forms and instructions list into a compact inline format. The list of historical form versions was retained but reformatted, and the last update date was set to September 22, 2026.
analysis.impact: The changes are primarily presentational and do not alter the data collection requirements of the FR Y-14M form. Users will see a reorganized layout of the page and a condensed historical forms list, but the underlying reporting obligations remain unchanged.
analysis.affected_scope: Users accessing the FR Y-14M reporting form page on the Federal Reserve website, including bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, and intermediate holding companies that file the FR Y-14M report.
analysis.actions: Review the updated FR Y-14M page for the new layout and confirm that the historical form versions and instructions are still accessible. No filing or submission actions are required as a result of these presentational changes.
analysis.reason: The Federal Reserve updated the page to improve navigation and presentation of the FR Y-14M form and its historical revisions, consolidating the menu and historical form list into a more compact format.

analysis.topic: Small Business Lending Survey (FR_2028D) and Related Reporting Forms
analysis.summary: The reporting forms index has been updated to restructure the presentation of reporting forms. The 'Small Business Lending Survey' (FR_2028D) and other forms have been consolidated into a single row with multiple forms listed together, replacing the previous multi-row format. The last update was recorded as September 29, 2026.
analysis.impact: This change affects the organization and accessibility of reporting forms for financial institutions, particularly those required to submit the Small Business Lending Survey and related data to the Federal Reserve. The consolidation simplifies navigation but requires systems to adapt to the new tabular format.
analysis.affected_scope: Small Business Lending Survey (FR_2028D) and associated reporting forms including June 2025, December 2024, September 2023, March 2023, December 2020, August 2018, December 2017, and August 2018 forms.
analysis.actions: Regulators should ensure compliance with the updated format by updating internal systems and guidance to reflect the consolidated listing of forms. Institutions must continue to file the specified reports using the correct form identifiers (e.g., FR_2028D).
analysis.reason: Modernization of the reporting forms index to improve clarity and organization of information collections under review.

analysis.topic: Federal Reserve FR Y-9C Reporting Form Page Update
analysis.summary: The Federal Reserve Board's FR Y-9C (Consolidated Financial Statements for Holding Companies) form page has been updated with a redesigned web layout. The main navigation menu was restructured into a row and column format, the public release text was condensed, and the historical forms listing section was significantly altered or truncated.
analysis.impact: Users navigating the Federal Reserve reporting forms portal to access the FR Y-9C form, instructions, or historical archives will encounter a modified interface and navigation structure, which may affect how they locate specific historical documents.
analysis.affected_scope: Users of the Federal Reserve reporting forms website, particularly those seeking consolidated financial statement forms for holding companies.
analysis.actions: Review the updated FR Y-9C page to understand the new navigation layout and locate the current form, instructions, and historical files.

analysis.summary: The FR Y-14Q reporting forms page was reformatted, consolidating form and instruction entries into single lines and adding row/column markers for improved layout.
analysis.impact: Minimal impact on users; changes affect page navigation only and do not alter reporting obligations.
analysis.affected_scope: Bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, intermediate holding companies, and other users accessing the FR Y-14Q reporting forms page.
analysis.actions: No action required beyond noting the updated page layout; users may update bookmarks or saved links if needed.

analysis.topic: FR 2028b/s Survey of Terms of Bank Lending to Farmers/Prime Rate Supplement reporting forms
analysis.summary: The Federal Reserve reporting forms page was reformatted from a multi-section layout with separate navigation categories to a simplified tabular format, consolidating information collections under review, recent updates, application filing information, and historical form listings into a single row structure
analysis.impact: Minimal impact on reporting requirements; the page structure and navigation changed but the actual forms, instructions, and submission requirements remain unchanged
analysis.affected_scope: Users accessing the FR 2028b/s reporting forms page at the Federal Reserve website
analysis.actions: Review the updated page structure to locate required forms and instructions for the Survey of Terms of Bank Lending to Farmers/Prime Rate Supplement
analysis.reason: Website reformatting to improve navigation and information presentation for reporting form access
